question: Mahatma Gandhi started the Dandi March in 1930 from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati Ashram, Gujarat**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi started the Dandi March from **Sabarmati Ashram, Gujarat**__.
 
• Dandi March is also known as **Salt Satyagraha.**
 
• Mahatma Gandhi sent a letter on **March 2, 1930**, to inform the Viceroy **Lord Irwin **that he and the others would begin breaking the Salt Laws in **10 days**. 
 
• The march spanned **240 miles (390 km)**, from **Sabarmati Ashram** to **Dandi**, which was called **Navsari **at that time (now in the state of Gujarat)
 
• He began his journey on **12th March** and broke the salt law by generating salt from seawater on** 6th April 1930.**
 
• On **5th May**, Mahatma Gandhi was arrested.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Salt Satyagraha was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi against the **salt tax** that was imposed by the British Government in India.
 
• Salt was a commodity used by all people of every community and the poor people were affected more by the salt tax.
 
• Until the passing of the **1882 Salt Act,** Indians were making salt from seawater free of cost.
 
• But the Salt Act gave the British a monopoly over the production of salt and the authority to impose a salt tax.
